property_summary: For any admissible caller and amount, if a Collect succeeds and the caller's balance decreases, the reference contract must have required both acc.balance >= MinSum and block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime before the withdrawal; the bug allows Collect to succeed and debit when the balance is below MinSum or the funds are still locked.
change_summary: Disable the balance/unlockTime guard so Collect succeeds whenever _am <= acc.balance, even if below MinSum or before unlockTime.
